title: IDLC Handoff Artifact
description: The contract every IDLC agent must emit when it finishes a stage. The next agent consumes this and MUST NOT proceed unless status == 'passed'. This schema is identical across all four POCs - only the orchestration engine that reads/writes it changes.

stage.description: Which IDLC stage produced this handoff.

consumer.description: Agent id expected to consume this next. Null if terminal.

status.description: Gate result. 'needs_human_review' pauses the pipeline in human-in-the-loop mode.

artifacts.description: Concrete files this stage produced (relative repo paths).

gate.description: Quality-gate evidence. The orchestrator decides pass/fail from this.

score.description: 0..1 confidence the stage output is acceptable.

open_questions.description: Blocking questions for a human. If non-empty, status should be needs_human_review.
